bluetooth_confirm.description:
Set up {name} ({address})?

Close the Govee app first: the strip accepts only one Bluetooth connection at a time.

manual.description: No strip is advertising right now (it stops advertising while the Govee app is connected to it). Enter its Bluetooth MAC address.

data_description.address: For example A4:C1:38:12:34:56. The last 4 characters of the advertised name (ihoment_H613D_XXXX) are the end of it.

abort.already_in_progress: Setup of this strip is already in progress.
abort.not_supported: This Govee device is not supported by this integration.

data_description.keep_connected: On: instant commands, and changes made with the control box or the app show up in Home Assistant, but one Bluetooth connection slot stays in use and the Govee app cannot connect. Off: connects only for commands and disconnects after 30 s.
data_description.color_dialect: Which colour frame the firmware understands. If colours do nothing, try the other one.
data_description.brightness_scale: Range of the firmware's brightness level. Auto switches to 0-255 as soon as the strip reports a level above 100.

send_raw.name: Send raw frame
send_raw.description: Developer tool: sends one raw BLE frame to the strip and returns every notification it sends back.

frame.name: Frame
frame.description: Hex bytes, e.g. 33 05 02 ff 00 00. Up to 19 bytes are padded and get their checksum; 20 bytes are sent as typed.

listen.name: Listen
listen.description: How long to collect the strip's replies.
